Cache hit with OpenDAL memory backend returns cached response on repeat request

```elixir title="Elixir"
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client_from_json("{\"api_key\":\"your-api-key\",\"cache\":{\"backend\":\"opendal:memory\",\"max_entries\":256,\"ttl_seconds\":300}}")
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_chat_async(client, "{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o\"}")
IO.inspect(result)
```
